standard_prerequisites.name: Sections of a quasi-coherent module over an open subset of a Noetherian scheme correspond to maps from a power of the quasi-coherent ideal sheaf of the closed complement
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the extension problem for the section into an extension problem for maps.

standard_prerequisites.name: An injective object of the category of quasi-coherent modules admits extensions of maps along the inclusion of the ideal sheaf into the structure sheaf
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the extending map from which the global section is read off.

core_obligations: Let U be open and s in J(U); let I be the quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals defining the reduced induced scheme structure on X \ U (Schemes, Definition reduced-induced-scheme); by Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma homs-over-open the section s corresponds to a map sigma : I^n to J for some n (proof lines 1958-1965).

By injectivity of J in QCoh(O_X), extend sigma along I^n to O_X to a map s-tilde : O_X to J; the image of 1 is a global section of J whose restriction to U is s, proving flasqueness (proof lines 1965-1969).
proof_roadmap: Encode the section as a map from a power of the ideal sheaf (proof lines 1958-1965).
Extend by injectivity and read off the global section (proof lines 1965-1969).
difficulty_reason: 19 行、两步：①把 U 上的截面经 coherent-lemma-homs-over-open 编码成映射 σ:I^n→J（I 是补集的既约诱导理想层）；②J 在 QCoh 中内射 ⇒ σ 沿 I^n ⊂ O_X 延拓成 O_X→J，其像即延拓截面。承重的编码与延拓两步都在 span 内；2 处跨章引用作导航桩。这是 Noetherian 概形上内射拟凝聚层烈度论证（ghost/fasqueness）的标准入口。
